gloss: flesh and blood; living body; mortal body

definitions.gloss: flesh and blood; living body; mortal body
definitions.explanation: The actual physical body of a living human being, as opposed to something mechanical, digital, or supernatural.

examples.japanese: {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、{生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}したい→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to talk to a real person, not a robot.

examples.japanese: {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, living) and ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body). Emphasizes the vulnerability and reality of the physical human body.

USAGE:
Almost always appears in the phrase {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ (a flesh-and-blood human) or {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (a mortal body). Used when contrasting real people with machines, virtual beings, or superhuman entities. Carries a nuance of human vulnerability and physicality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ — a real, flesh-and-blood human
- {生身|なまみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ — a mortal/physical body
- {生身|なまみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — with one's bare body; unprotected
